Testline Cargo | Air export tariff
Currency    EUR
Valid from  01.11.2026
Valid to    30.11.2026
All rates are per kg of chargeable weight, in EUR.
Fuel and security surcharges are charged per kg of the weight the freight is billed on.
The minimum charge applies to the freight before surcharges.

Lane  Transit  Minimum  -45  +45  +100
CGN-SYD  3  EUR 30.00  EUR 2.00  EUR 2.00  EUR 2.00
DUS-JFK  3  EUR 30.00  EUR 4.00  EUR 4.00  EUR 4.00

Surcharges per kg of billed weight
CGN-SYD: fuel EUR 0.20 per kg, security EUR 0.10 per kg
DUS-JFK: fuel EUR 0.20 per kg, security EUR 0.10 per kg
